description: Find web pages with Bing titles, URLs, snippets and ranks. Use for an alternative search index; for Google results use google_search. Required: query.

cc.description: Two-letter country code such as us; omit for source default, mutually exclusive with mkt. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

count.description: Requested result count, integer 1-50; actual count varies, omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

filters.description: Opaque Bing filters copied from a Bing search URL; omitted means no explicit filter. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

first.description: Starting result position, integer at least 1; default 1. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

lat.description: GPS latitude for search origin; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

lon.description: GPS longitude for search origin; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

mkt.description: Market such as en-US; omit for source default, mutually exclusive with cc. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required web search keywords; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

safeSearch.description: Adult-content filter: Off, Moderate or Strict; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: bing_search
title: Bing web search results
